notes.title: State Of The Game
notes.content:
Game rewrite
 Over the past year or so, the game has become increasingly complex to the point where small issues are hard to fix due to the spaghetti code (my fault). As a result, I’ll be rewriting the entire game from scratch, which will delay its release by possibly a year. 

Alongside the five existing levels (stages), I’ll be adding new ones and improving support for modding,
